gloss: in an instant; in a flash; instantly

definitions.gloss: in an instant; in a flash; instantly
definitions.explanation: Describes something happening in an extremely short moment. Formed from {一瞬|いっしゅん} (a moment) plus the particle で marking the span of time over which something occurs.

examples.japanese: {一瞬|いっしゅん}で{消|き}えた。
{火|ひ}は{一瞬|いっしゅん}で{広|ひろ}がった。
examples.english: The fire spread in a flash.

examples.japanese: {彼|かれ}の{一言|ひとこと}で、{場|ば}の{空気|くうき}が{一瞬|いっしゅん}で{変|か}わった。
examples.english: With one word from him, the mood of the room changed in an instant.

notes:
Adverbial phrase built from the noun {一瞬|いっしゅん} (a moment, a split second) plus で.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {一瞬|いっしゅん}で{終|お}わる: to be over in an instant
- {一瞬|いっしゅん}で{消|き}える: to disappear instantly
- {一瞬|いっしゅん}で{判断|はんだん}する: to decide in a split second

SIMILAR WORDS:
- あっという{間|ま}に: in the blink of an eye — emphasizes that time passed faster than expected
- {瞬時|しゅんじ}に: instantaneously — more formal and technical
